title: CI skips whole jobs, and the checks job's unflagged pull_request lint steps, when a change touches nothing they read
why: Owner 11:20 CST Nov 13, relayed by runner 10 and the coordinator: a prose-only batch still starts about 19 jobs and runs the lint steps. Ruled by decisions test-strategy-reset ("Each CI job runs only when a file that its suites read changes") and ci-cut-in-steps (item 31), never built.
source: owner 11:20 CST Nov 13 via runner 10; coordinator 11:21 CST; retrospective 11:19 CST
note: Scope: whole jobs, and the unflagged pull_request lint steps in the checks job (.github/workflows/checks.yml about lines 445 to 564), skipped when the change touches no file they read. Caveat from steps guard-pr-runs-windows-shards and rollup-needs-all-shards: a job-level skip needs the all-jobs-passed rollup to accept a skipped job; the coordinator's 14:25 CST Nov 12 pick gates by step instead. Overlaps lane ci-mac-once-per-batch (same file, checks.yml). First measure: runner 10's job minutes for batch 133. Express (ruling drain-first-hold part 4: a CI fix). Lane started by the coordinator 11:21 CST Nov 13. Measure (retrospective 11:22 CST Nov 13, batch 133): the 19 short jobs cost 3.0 job-minutes and about 0 wall time, so job-level skips save little. The checks job runs about 93 unflagged suite steps (29.4 step-minutes so far, still running) on a docs-only diff. First fix: step-level code flags on checks suites that read no .md. It avoids the rollup blocker. Lane order (coordinator 11:22 CST): steps first, then jobs.
